card.name: Connectors inside symptom and color lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and spaces inside lists of symptoms, colors or lab thresholds, right before the next list item or number. Often in overdose or toxicity symptom lists.

modes.label: Symptom lists
modes.description: The 'and' or comma between items in a list of overdose or toxicity signs.
modes.example: The signs and symptoms of overdose are headache, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot<< and>> dry skin, dizziness, dryness

modes.label: Color pairs
modes.description: A linking word between or after color terms in descriptions of appearance.
modes.example: The variable eggfly butterfly mimics the high contrast black<< and>> white wing coloration of three poisonous species

modes.label: Lab thresholds
modes.description: The space before a number in bilirubin or ULN cutoffs.
modes.example: 8 times the ULN or total bilirubin increases to more than<< >>1.5 and up to 3

card.writes: It suppresses gray-related words, so it steers the next word away from 'gray' after color or symptom list connectors.
card.plain: It fires on the small joining words in lists of symptoms or colors, just before the next item.
